name: SSHI_FBR_LC_Filter
rationale: The previous SSHI-FBR design provided sufficient power (vavg) but suffered from high output ripple (vpp) and slow settling/startup (dv, tup) due to the trade-off in storage capacitor C1 size. By adding a filter inductor L2 between the rectifier bridge and the storage capacitor, we create an LC low-pass filter. This suppresses the high-current spikes inherent to the SSHI inversion process, allowing us to significantly reduce the value of C1. A smaller C1 will shorten the system time constant (tau = RL * C1), thereby improving startup time and settling behavior without sacrificing ripple performance.
